LanguageData.Gun_L85A2_RWP.description: A British-made assault rifle, the L85A2 features a bullpup design that balances accuracy and compactness. With a high rate of fire and good range, it's well-suited for medium to long-range engagements. Rugged and reliable, it's an excellent choice for colonists who need versatility in battle.
